name: 瑞雯·磨镜
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:269
who: Raven, a demon-kin woman of the dream folk, a shadow-walker from a family of black-glass mirror grinders on the lake shore of the city of dream mirrors, the listener of a deep-level party, a hundred and fifty but looking about thirty: tall, about 175 cm, thin-backed and narrow-shouldered, walking without a sound. Long deep plum hair in one braid to the waist, a small polished chip of obsidian tied to its end. Pale silver-blue eyes like a wiped mirror, catching lamplight in the dark. Cold white skin; three thin silver rings along the rim of her left ear. Her shadow is heavier than other people's, pooling like spilled ink even in daylight. A quiet, cool, listening air; she has never dreamed in her life. Her left ear has only three thin silver rings along its upper rim; no dangling earring, no cross, nothing gold at her ears.
build: 175 cm, tall and slender: a thin back and narrow shoulders, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep plum and ink grey, pale silver-blue, dull brass, a glow of dark red
casual: Her deep-level gear: a long ink-grey cloak with the hood up and pulled low to the brow, the face still clear; under it close-fitting soft leather armour with thick leather sewn over the knees and elbows, for pressing against stone to listen; dark trousers and soft boots. At her belt hangs her family's brass lamp, its shade a ring of thin-ground obsidian through which the light comes out dark red, with a short curved blade and a coil of thin cord; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem, an astrolabe with linked stars, is tied flat under her collar so it never clinks. She carries nothing else that could make a sound. One hand is raised a little, the fingers spread, asking for silence; a cool, listening look.
private: Awake at night in her party's rented rooms in the bell-tower quarter: a loose dark grey linen shirt with long sleeves, a washed-out plum wool cardigan with a darned elbow, slim dark trousers, soft felt slippers, the braid over one shoulder. She turns the obsidian chip at the end of her braid between her fingers, listening to the others sleep, a faint, quiet smile. Slim dark wool trousers with a plain waistband, no drawstring.
battle: Going down past the fog gates: the ink-grey cloak belted close, the soft leather armour with its thick knee and elbow pads, leather bracers, the coil of thin cord across her chest, the brass lamp lit at her belt and glowing dark red through its obsidian shade. She grips the short curved blade low in her right hand; her left hand reaches back behind her, open, as if for someone to hold it. A still, intent look.
formal: Dressed as the mirror grinders of her home city dress for the night lessons of the Mirror Hall: a long deep violet-grey wool dress with long sleeves and a high collar fastened to the throat by a row of small polished obsidian buttons, a dark plum sash, a short black shoulder cape, soft dark boots, the obsidian chip at the end of her braid. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a cool, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the head turned a little as if listening, the pale silver-blue eyes looking past the viewer toward a wall of grey fog. A dark red glow from the obsidian-shaded brass lamp rises from below on one side, against cold grey fog light. Foreground blur: drifting fog, the swinging obsidian chip at the end of her braid and a taut thin cord. She wears the ink-grey cloak over soft leather armour.
art_extra: Her hair keeps its own deep plum colour as in the sprite, not crimson or magenta; the red lamp light only rims its edge.

name: 蒂丽·瓦脊
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:325
who: Tilly, a cat-eared beastfolk woman of the rooftops of the lower city, from a family of tile menders who walk the ridgelines, the guild's runner, twenty-two: short and slight, about 152 cm, long-legged, always standing on the toes of one foot. Messy short orange-red hair sticking up every way; orange-red cat ears with dark tiger stripes; honey-yellow eyes whose pupils open round in the dark; a few freckles across the bridge of the nose. A long orange-red tail with tiger stripes, the tip bent in a crooked kink where a door caught it when she was small. A curved scar across the palm of her left hand from the edge of a roof tile. A quick, chattering, restless air.
build: 152 cm, small and slight with long legs: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: orange-red and tiger-stripe brown, honey yellow, tin grey, a wisp of blue-orange smoke
casual: Her runner's gear: a short leather jacket with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and a row of pockets sewn across the front, one thing in each: a flint, a twist of smoke powder, a stick of chalk, half a loaf of bread; slim trousers bound below the knee with soft leather leg wraps, thin-soled shoes. On her back a narrow woven cane basket, its rim at her shoulders, holding a dozen palm-sized tin smoke pots with holes punched in their lids; the guild's bronze wind-road rank emblem, a wind feather over a curving road and an arrow, on a cord at her neck. Her scarred left hand on the basket strap, the tail curled up behind her, she leans forward on her toes, a quick, bright, questioning look.
private: At home in her family's attic at the top of Grey Lane: a faded cotton shirt with patched elbows, a short knitted vest, rolled-up trousers, bare feet, the tail wrapped round one ankle. She holds the half loaf of bread she never eats, kept for the first hungry person she reaches, a cheeky, softened grin.
battle: Running the shaft with smoke: the leather jacket buttoned up, leather bracers, the leg wraps pulled tight, the basket of tin smoke pots strapped close on her back. In her right hand she holds up a lit tin smoke pot trailing a thread of bluish smoke with a tinge of orange; her scarred left hand is open and reaching forward, ready to grab someone who falls. She carries no weapon; ears up, a fierce, quick look. The curved pale scar from a roof tile runs clearly across the open palm of her left hand; the basket of smoke pots stays on her back, its rim at her shoulders.
battle_pose: 3) the running outfit: alert and ready, the feet a little apart and up on the toes, a firm expression, holding up a lit tin smoke pot in one hand, the scarred other hand open and reaching forward to catch someone; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day the guild names her smoke trail the wind-road beacon: a clean dark blue wool short coat buttoned to the collar, a little big in the shoulders, a white collar, the bronze wind-road emblem on its cord, slim dark trousers and polished boots, her hair combed flat for once with the tufts already springing up, the tail brushed. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, the ears pinned back, a serious, slightly fidgety look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-yellow eyes wide and bright, the cat ears up, a lit tin smoke pot held close beside her cheek, its thin trail of blue-orange smoke curling across the frame. Warm low evening sun from one side over a slope of roof tiles. Foreground blur: drifting smoke, the edge of a roof ridge and a grey pigeon feather. She wears the short leather jacket with its row of pockets.

name: 费边·策勒
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:381
who: Fabian Zeller, a human boy of the lampless Grey Lane in the lower city, sixteen, newly awakened and holding only an apprentice's seal, the son of a furnace hand who went down the shaft and never came up: about 168 cm and still growing, lanky, big hands and feet, wholly covered by his clothes, the sleeves always a little short. Messy flaxen hair cut unevenly by his mother with her laundry shears. Sky-blue eyes that squint for a moment in bright light, as all the Grey Lane children do. A nose tip red from the cold; a small piece missing from his left eyebrow where he struck a wall corner as a child. A plain, stubborn, quiet air: he answers one question at a time.
palette: flaxen and sky blue, washed-out grey homespun, iron grey, a little soot black
casual: His only clothes: a coarse cloth coat washed almost white, its sleeves too short and lengthened by his mother with a band of cloth of a different colour, a plain shirt, patched brown trousers and worn boots; a length of rope for a belt with a borrowed short sword tied to it, the scabbard longer than the blade; the guild's small bronze apprentice emblem, a folded little star over a simple compass, on a cord at his neck; an iron nail tucked inside his coat, picked up by the furnaces under the lift shaft where his father worked. He stands very straight, a serious, unsmiling look.
private: At home in Grey Lane: an old knitted jumper of his father's, far too big, the cuffs rolled back twice, patched trousers and worn boots. He turns the iron nail over in his fingers, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Keeping count at the floor stone: an old boiled-leather jerkin from the guild store, a size too big, buckled over the washed-out coat, a small shielded lantern at his belt, the borrowed short sword in its too-long scabbard at his side, never drawn. He grips the iron nail in one fist, about to scratch another tally mark; he does not fight.
battle_pose: 3) the counting outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted, a firm, unsmiling expression, gripping an iron nail in one fist close to the body as if about to scratch a mark on stone; the borrowed short sword stays sheathed at his side and he does not fight.
formal: At the reading of names on Ceasefire Day, where his father's name is read: his mother's mended best, a clean grey-blue wool jacket a size too big, buttoned to the collar over a white shirt, the small bronze apprentice emblem pinned on, the uneven hair wetted down flat. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, a solemn, stubborn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the sky-blue eyes squinting a little into a pale light, a stubborn, unsmiling look. Cold grey fog light from one side and the warm glow of a lantern from below. Foreground blur: drifting fog, an iron nail and rows of tally marks scratched on grey stone, four strokes crossed by a fifth. He wears the washed-out coat with the mismatched band at the cuff.

name: 雪莉·隙行
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:566
who: Shirley, a demon-kin woman of the night-stalker folk of the Red Garden, from a family that for generations led drunken guests out through the slits in the curtains, now head of a party that guides others down to the fog gates, ninety-two but looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: small and thin, about 160 cm, light on her feet. Grey-pink hair cut level at the chin, one longer lock falling over the forehead. Pomegranate-red eyes that glow a little in the dark. Cold white matte skin that does not shine under lamplight, so she vanishes in the dark. When she smiles a single small fang peeks over her lower lip on the left. An old ring of bite marks on her left thumb. A teasing, quick-tongued air; at work, not one wasted word.
face: FACE, as in the references: medium-large, sharp, gently slanted almond eyes of pomegranate red, NOT big round doll eyes, with a thin tapering dark upper lash line; thin brows under the long front lock; a tiny nose; a small mouth with a teasing smile in which a single small pointed fang peeks over the lower lip on the left; a neat pointed chin. Cool white matte skin with very little shading and no shine, skin shadows a soft cool mauve.
build: 160 cm, small and thin: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: black leather and grey-pink, pomegranate red, crimson lining, a little dull bronze
casual: Her guide's gear: close-fitting black soft leather armour and over it a short cloak worn inside out, so its Red Garden crimson lining is hidden and only the dull black shows; two short knives at her belt and a leather pouch bulging with more black rye loaves than knives; slim dark trousers and soft boots; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord. She holds out a small black rye loaf in one hand as if pressing it on someone, a teasing grin with the fang showing.
private: Back in town at her lodging by the shaft mouth: a loose dark wine-red wool shirt with long sleeves, slim black trousers, soft boots, the short cloak hung over one shoulder crimson side out. She tears a black rye loaf in half, a lazy, amused look.
battle: Taking a party down to the gate: the black soft leather armour buckled close, the short cloak dark side out, leather bracers, the pouch of bread tied tight. She holds the two short knives low, one in each hand, a bead of blood on her bitten left thumb, light on her feet, a sharp, unsmiling look.
formal: Back in the city, dressed for the guild hall: a fitted black jacket with a high collar and small dark buttons, the short cloak turned crimson side out over her shoulders, black gloves, slim black trousers and polished boots, the bronze star-chart emblem pinned at the collar. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a composed look with a hint of mischief.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, half of it peering out between two heavy dark curtains, the pomegranate-red eyes catching a little light, a teasing grin with the small fang showing. Cold dim grey-white light of a fog gate from one side, her matte skin barely catching it. Foreground blur: the crimson lining of a cloak, a torn black rye loaf and single drops of blood glowing faintly on dark stone. She wears the black leather armour and the short cloak.

name: 伍迪·望雾
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:622
who: Woody, a rabbit-eared beastfolk man of the Mist-Watcher family at the shaft mouth, a guide who reads the colour of the fog at the fog gates, twenty-four: tall and slender, about 178 cm, long-legged, able to leap a ditch as wide as an ore cart. A pair of long cream-white rabbit ears tipped with pale chestnut, the left one standing up and the right one folded over. Short pale hair the colour of ripe wheat. Misty blue eyes that narrow to slits when he studies fog. A thin scar across the bridge of the nose from a fall on the stone railing at the shaft mouth. A talkative, jumpy, honest air: his legs go weak and he walks on anyway.
palette: cream white and pale chestnut, wheat gold, misty blue, grey-green, a little copper
casual: His guide's gear: a grey-green short jacket with a strip of his family's grey cloth sewn round each cuff, a pale shirt, dark trousers and soft boots; a short bow and a quiver on his back, a bread pouch at his belt; the guild's bronze laurel rank emblem, a laurel branch around the guild star, on a cord. He holds upright beside him the chest-high copper rod he carries at his belt, a small white cloth tied to its tip so he can see which way the fog leans. His ears uneven, he squints sideways, a nervous, attentive look.
private: At home at the shaft mouth: a loose cream knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, brown trousers and soft shoes. He holds his own copper rod across both hands, its length marked with many small lines, one for each change of colour he has seen in the fog, a quiet, wistful look.
battle: Watching a white fog gate: the grey-green jacket buttoned up under a fitted leather jerkin, leather bracers, the copper rod with its white cloth slung across his back, the quiver at his side. He holds the short bow with an arrow nocked, the string not drawn, both ears up, a pale, determined look.
formal: Called before the guild council to report on the white gate: a clean grey-green wool coat buttoned to the collar, the grey family strip at the cuffs, the bronze laurel emblem pinned at the chest, the ears brushed smooth. He stands very straight, both ears up for once, a solemn, slightly anxious look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the misty blue eyes narrowed to slits as he studies the fog, one licked fingertip raised to find the draught, the long ears one up and one folded. Cold white light of a white fog gate from one side, his hair glowing pale gold. Foreground blur: drifting white fog, the strip of white cloth fluttering on a copper rod and a stub of charcoal. He wears the grey-green short jacket.

name: 蕾雅·帕斯洛
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:678
who: Reya Paslow, a human woman who grew up in the laundry-line lanes, the guild's deputy who becomes its second guildmaster this year, a legend who has looked twenty-three ever since she became one forty years ago: about 172 cm, slender and light, thin across the back and shoulders. Pale gold hair cut short and always tousled by the wind. Pale blue eyes, the colour of the light just before her gate of return opens. A smudge of charcoal always on her fingertips from sketching. Her old travelling clothes are covered with sewn-on cloth badges, one patched over another. A quick, clear, careful air: she counts the people first, then the doors, and money last.
build: 172 cm, slender and light: a thin back and shoulders, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: washed canvas white and pale gold, pale blue, faded patchwork colours, charcoal grey
casual: Her old travelling clothes: a canvas travelling jacket and trousers washed almost white, covered with sewn-on cloth badges of every colour and shape, the newer ones stitched beneath the old; on the left breast seven worn badges side by side over a small homemade badge she sewed at twelve; at her belt a narrow-bladed short sword, her late father's copper-cased chalk-line box and a small sketchbook tied with string; the guild's bronze emblem of the highest grade, a seven-pointed star in a halo with ripples, on a cord; a paper folded in four tucked in her breast pocket. She holds the sketchbook and a stick of charcoal, a calm, counting look.
private: In the guild canteen after hours: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark wool vest, the canvas trousers and soft shoes, the hair messier than ever. battle: Ready to call a retreat: the washed-white canvas jacket under a fitted boiled-leather vest, leather bracers, a coil of rope over one shoulder, a small lantern at the belt. She holds the narrow-bladed short sword low in her right hand and her father's copper chalk-line box in her left, a taut white chalked line drawn out of it; a sharp, steady look.
formal: On the day she takes up the post of second guildmaster: the very same washed-white travelling clothes brushed clean, every badge in place, a plain dark grey short cape over one shoulder, the bronze seven-pointed star emblem pinned at the collar. She holds the paper folded in four in both hands in front of her, standing very upright, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale blue eyes looking past the viewer toward an open doorway, a faint, tired smile, the wind lifting the pale gold hair. Cold blue-white light before dawn from one side, as through the open doors of a great hall. Foreground blur: the end of a long wooden bench, an open sketchbook page with nine short upright strokes and drifting charcoal dust. She wears the washed-white canvas travelling clothes covered in cloth badges.
art_extra: Her earring is a short drop of small gold beads: no crescent and no moon shape anywhere. Her hair keeps its own silvery pale gold, not lilac.

name: 塔隆·黑燧
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:734
who: Talon, a fire-horn demon-kin man of the Black Flint clan of the mountains, the legend called the Flint at the Top of the Stair, nine hundred and eleven years old and looking about forty, as he has for more than five hundred years: tall, about 196 cm, broad and thick, with long arms. Two straight horns with black tips, each split by two cracks through which a dark red fire glows like banked coals. Short brick-red hair, black at the roots. Golden-red eyes that can see which shapes in the dark are still warm. A pale frost-crack scar on his left arm. On a leather cord at his neck an old wooden tag branded with a boundary-stone number, beside his mountain-copper guild seal. A slow, silent, steadfast air: he always stands on someone's left. Both horns are straight, rising from the brow like two short spikes angled slightly back, not curved or hooked.
face: FACE, as in the references: a mature man's face of about forty, broad and calm, NOT old: narrow golden-red eyes under straight heavy brows, a couple of faint lines at their corners; a straight nose; a closed, patient mouth; a strong jaw. Fair skin with a faint warm red tint and very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm red-brown. His skin is fair and light with only a faint warm red tint: NOT tanned, NOT brown.
build: 196 cm, tall, broad and thick: wide shoulders, a broad back and long arms.
palette: brick red and flint black, banked-coal red, golden red, worn leather brown, a little mountain copper
casual: His guild gear: old guild leather armour with a copper plate nailed on the left shoulder engraved with the guild's scale, a dark wool shirt, dark trousers and heavy boots; on a leather cord at his neck the wooden tag and the mountain-copper seal, a trace of black left in the groove of the scale around its rim; a camp register whose pages have all gone blank and white tucked into the front of his armour. At his belt hangs a long-handled stone-breaking hammer, one face of its head flat and the other pointed. One big hand rests on the hammer's handle, a slow, steady look.
private: Off watch by the barrier at the top of the long stair: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the pale scar on his left arm showing, dark trousers and heavy boots, the tag and seal at his neck. He holds the blank white camp register closed in one hand and looks down into the palm of the other, a quiet, heavy look.
battle: Bringing people up through the tide: the old leather armour with the copper scale plate under an iron-plated leather cuirass, leather bracers, heavy boots, the register still tucked inside. He grips the long-handled stone-breaking hammer in both hands across his body, the fire in his horn cracks flaring; a still, watchful look. The copper plate engraved with the scale is on his LEFT shoulder, as in the other outfits.
formal: At the reading of names before the board of the missing on Ceasefire Day: the old leather armour brushed clean, the copper scale plate polished, a long dark grey wool mantle, the wooden tag and the seal at his neck. He stands very upright with the long hammer set head down on the ground before him, both hands resting on the end of its handle, a grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the golden-red eyes looking down at the viewer, steady and heavy, the dark red fire glowing in the cracks of his black-tipped horns. A cold white light from one side, like a pale fire that gives no warmth, against warm red embers. Foreground blur: blank white pages fluttering loose, drifting sparks and the wooden tag on its cord. He wears the old leather armour with the copper scale plate on the shoulder.
art_extra: His hair is short, as in the sprite, ending above the collar; no long flowing hair.

name: 莱恩哈特·奥兰

who: Reinhardt Oran, a human knight of the Oran house in the upper town of the golden kite city, a general of the Dawn's eastern army and keeper of the east gate of the White Stele Wall, fifty-six, a hero who ages slowly and looks about fifty: a younger version of this person, before he became a legend. Tall, about 189 cm, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, standing like a planted banner. Platinum hair grown to the nape and tied back with a leather cord, a short, neatly trimmed platinum beard. Steady amber eyes, as most of the Orans have. A polished copper thimble on the ring finger of his left hand, put there by his wife on their wedding day. A warm, plain, honest air; he remembers every soldier's full name.
face: FACE, as in the references: a handsome, mature man's face of about fifty, NOT old: fine lines at the eye corners and across the brow, strong straight platinum brows, steady amber eyes; a straight nose; a firm mouth framed by a short, neatly trimmed platinum beard; a strong jaw. build: 189 cm, tall with broad shoulders and a thick back, a knight's build from the academy and twenty years of cavalry charges.
palette: white steel and worn gold, platinum, amber, faded garrison blue, a little copper
casual: His general's armour: white steel plate edged with a single line of gold, its paint worn pale by the wind and grit of the wall, an arrow hole in the upper left of the breastplate left unmended; at his hip a long sword in a white scabbard with a gold kite, the champion's sword; on the other side a small sewing pouch with a roll of coarse flag-mending thread peeking out; the copper thimble on his left ring finger. private: Off duty in his room at the signal-platform yard: a plain cream linen shirt open at the collar, a dark brown wool waistcoat, dark trousers and worn boots, the hair tied back with the leather cord. He holds a letter from his children, reading it with a warm, quiet smile.
battle: The night at the broken east gate: the white-steel general's plate with its unmended arrow hole, a short white cape scorched at the hem, steel gauntlets. formal: The dress uniform of a general of the Dawn's eastern army: a long white wool coat with a stand collar, gold piping and a row of brass buttons, the gold kite badge of the eastern army and a few medal ribbons on the chest, a short white cape on one shoulder, the champion's sword in its white-and-gold scabbard at his hip, white gloves, the left glove carried in his hand so the copper thimble shows. He stands very upright, a grave, patient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the steady amber eyes looking at the viewer through falling snow, a faint, rueful half-smile, the platinum hair and beard glowing in the light. Warm white-gold light gathers on him from one side, like the point of a charging wedge, against the cold blue of a night siege. Foreground blur: a torn garrison flag with clumsy stitches, a needle on coarse thread and drifting snow. He wears the white-steel plate edged with gold, the arrow hole in the breastplate.

Deep bronze-coloured skin with faint pale violet lines climbing her arms and neck that glow in a thunderstorm. Blue-black hair in one thick braid coiled between her horns. Two horns curving forward, wound round and round with thick hemp rope so a child's hand can hold on. Copper-green eyes. A slow, weighing, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a mature woman's face of about thirty-eight, broad-boned and calm: medium almond eyes of copper green, faint lines at their corners; level dark brows; a firm, kind mouth. formal: At the reading of names on Ceasefire Day at the Severed Gate: the dark armour cleaned with its scorch marks left as they are, a long heavy grey wool cloak over the shoulders, the star-chart emblem and the small shield-patterned war badge pinned side by side at the breast, fresh hemp rope bound on her horns. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the copper-green eyes calm and steady, her head bowed a little so the rope-bound horns lean toward the viewer, as if for a child to grab. Warm orange torchlight from one side against a cold snowy night, the pale violet lines on her neck glowing faintly. Foreground blur: falling snow, the riveted edge of an iron door with its small barred slot and a frayed end of hemp rope. She wears the dark scorched Thunder-Gaol armour.

name: 圭多·七钟
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:1012
who: Guido, a demon-kin man of the bone folk from the city of bone bells, named under its seventh bell tower, where for a hundred years he read out the names of the dead, now the guild's caller of names; about a hundred and sixty-four, in the prime of his folk, his age impossible to read: tall and thin, about 186 cm, narrow-shouldered, as straight as a bell rope. Skin white as fine porcelain; both hands bare white bone from the knuckles to the fingertips. In the middle of his chest a palm-wide opening without skin shows clean white ribs, and between them hangs a small bronze bell on a black cord tied to his collarbone.
